title: fuzzpot JSONL log line
description: Contract shared by go-fuzzpot (producer) and fuzz-sec-intel (consumer). This file is byte-identical in both repositories; contract tests in both repos validate against it. Changing it requires coordinated commits in both repos.

v.description: Schema version. Lines written before versioning exist lack this field and are treated by consumers as v1-compatible. v2 adds the optional `truncated` flag and first-byte `ts` timestamps with sub-second precision. v3 adds the `sensor` instance identity.

ts.description: Event timestamp, RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 with timezone offset. Since v2: time of the first payload byte (not capture completion), at nanosecond precision when the clock provides it.

size.description: Payload size in bytes. Since v2 this never exceeds the producer's max_payload_size.

printable.description: Printable-ASCII rendering of the payload (may be empty).

hex.description: Lowercase hex dump of the full payload; omitted when log_hex_payload is disabled.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw payload (64 lowercase hex chars); omitted only in very old producers.

truncated.description: v2 only: true when capture stopped at max_payload_size — more bytes may have followed. A payload exactly max_payload_size bytes long is also flagged (conservatively). Omitted when false; v1 lines carry no truncation information.

sensor.description: v3+: identity of the honeypot instance that captured the line (config sensor.name, defaulting to the host name). Always present and non-empty since v3; absent on v1/v2 lines, which consumers treat as sensor "" (unknown). Printable ASCII without spaces, at most 253 bytes.
